description: NEW JERSEY – Congresswomen Bonnie Watson Coleman (NJ-12) and LaMonica McIver (NJ-10) today endorsed Congressman Rob Menendez for re-election. Menendez has worked closely with both members and was at the Delaney Hall detention center alongside them last year in a confrontation with ICE and HSI agents that received national attention. “Rob Menendez has always stepped up […]
